# BrainActivityPrediction

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of LLM internal representations to predict fMRI or EEG responses, serving as a benchmark for model-brain alignment. Offers a quantitative method to validate whether TCC/iNEST systems produce representations compatible with neural encoding.
